main_body: wooden scroll shelf / bookcase with three open shelves
top_band: light tan wood band from row 0 to row 3 (with row 4 as front edge)
evidence: The shelf has a clear 4-5 row horizontal top surface (rows 0-4) in light tan wood, an overhang/inner shadow under the top edge at row 5, and recessed shelves showing horizontal shelf tops (rows 11, 19, 27) above their front edges (rows 12, 20, 28).
